# Rive test fixtures

Files here are for tests only. They are not under `assets/` and do not ship
in the app.

| File | From | Licence | Holds |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rocket.riv` | `example/assets/rocket.riv` in the `rive` package, version 0.14.11 | MIT, the package's `LICENSE` (Copyright (c) 2020 Rive) | One default artboard with one state machine, `Button` |
| `rating.riv` | `example/assets/rating.riv` in the same package | The same | One default artboard with one state machine, `State Machine 1` |

Used by `test/core/media/rive_render_test.dart` and `test/features/training/presentation/rive_renderer_render_test.dart`.
